rename.name: 0101-rename
rename.sql: UPDATE requirements SET id='RENAMED',text='after' WHERE id='TEMP'
rename.rollback_sql: UPDATE requirements SET id='TEMP',text='before' WHERE id='RENAMED'

link.sql: INSERT INTO requirements(id,level,status,text) VALUES('CHILD','application','current','child'); INSERT INTO requirement_links(system_id,application_id) VALUES('RENAMED','CHILD')
